title: BoardWs
description: Messages the backend pushes on the big-screen WebSocket (/ws/board?boardId=…). It only pushes; the owner's session cookie opens it, or a kiosk sends {type:'auth', token} as its first message. The server closes it with a WsCloseCode from game-ws-v1.json.

BigScreenScreen.title: BigScreenScreen
BigScreenScreen.description: idle: no game. game: the board's running game. result: a game that just finished, held for a minute.

snapshot.title: Snapshot
snapshot.description: Full session state, pushed after every change.

allOf.title: SnapshotBase
allOf.description: The envelope every game's snapshot shares; each <Game>Snapshot adds its gameId and game.

lobbyId.description: The lobby the game was started from; null for a local game.

lobbyName.description: The lobby's name, for the match header; null for a local game.

bmStatus.description: Status of the board of the seat that's up.

results.description: Each seat's place once the game has finished (won, or ended by a forfeit), in seat order, as the server saves it; null until then.

items.title: SeatPlace
items.description: A seat's final place: 1 for the winner; tied seats share one; a forfeit (a team's, in a team game) ranks last.

finishPending.description: The open visit wins the game: it waits for the Finish button (a takeout from the user), so its darts can still be corrected.

canUndoVisit.description: No darts are open and Undo would reopen the last committed visit (its thrower is up again, to correct it).

ownerUserId.description: The host: starts the bull off, aborts the game.

hasHost.description: Whether `ownerUserId` is a host who may end the game. A ranked or tournament game has none: nobody ends it for everyone and either side starts the bull off.

scoreBased.description: The game has a running score the caller announces (the game module's scoreBased).

items.title: SeatInfo
items.description: Who acts for a seat and where its darts come from.

userId.description: The account the seat plays for; null for a guest.

avatar.description: The account's profile picture; {kind: 'none'} for a guest or bot.
avatar.title: Avatar

foreground.description: The finish of the mark in front

background.description: The finish of the disc behind it

boardId.description: null: darts are entered by hand.

controllerConnected.description: The controller has this game open.

disconnectedAt.description: Server time the controller's last socket of this game closed; null while they have it open, or if they haven't opened it since the server started.

bot.description: The server throws for this seat itself, at this difficulty 1-20; null for a human or guest.

spectators.description: Friends watching the game right now (/ws?watch=1); missing: none.

voided.description: A moderator voided this ranked game while it ran: it ended without a result and moved nobody's rating.

anyOf.title: RankedState
anyOf.description: A ranked game's time limit, disconnect timers and stakes. The clock is the server's: a screen counts down from `now` (the server's time when the snapshot was built) and corrects itself with every snapshot.

mode.description: The queue the match came from.

visitSeconds.description: Time each visit gets before the reserve is used.

reserveSeconds.description: The reserve each seat (each team in a team game) starts with.

manualEntry.description: Darts may be entered by hand; when false the server rejects them.

visitDeadline.description: When the visit of the seat that is up runs over and its reserve starts to run. null: no visit clock is running (the bull off before the first visit, a finished game, a visit held for Finish); show the time as paused.

forfeitAt.description: When the seat that is up has used its whole reserve and forfeits the match. null exactly when visitDeadline is.

reserveSeconds.description: Reserve left at `now`, whole seconds, counting the open visit.

inReserve.description: The seat is up and its visit has run over, so its reserve is running.

disconnectForfeitAt.description: Its controller has the game closed: when the seat forfeits if they do not come back; null while they are connected.

stakes.description: RP the seat's side gains for a win and loses for a loss; null while placing.

rating.description: The player's rating (RP) when the match started; null while they are still in their placement matches (the hidden placement rating is never sent) and for a guest or bot.

rankIndex.description: The rank the player held when the match started, 0 (Wood I) to 29 (Elite V) as RankedRating.rankIndex; `rank(i)` from shared/ranked gives the Rank. null while placing.

played.description: Placement matches played before this one.

of.description: Placement matches a player plays before they get a rank.

placement.description: Progress through the placement matches; null once the player has a rank.

change.description: RP the match moved the player by (negative for a loss); null for a placement match, whose rating is hidden. Show `placement` progress instead, and rankIndexAfter on the match that finishes placing.

rankIndexAfter.description: null when the player is still placing after this match.

result.description: What the finished match did to the player's rating; null until the result is recorded (and for a guest, a bot, or a match that was not rated). Promoted is rankIndexAfter above rankIndexBefore.

ranked.description: A ranked game's rules and clock; null or missing for a game that is not ranked.

allOf.title: SnapshotBase
allOf.description: The envelope every game's snapshot shares; each <Game>Snapshot adds its gameId and game.

lobbyId.description: The lobby the game was started from; null for a local game.

lobbyName.description: The lobby's name, for the match header; null for a local game.

bmStatus.description: Status of the board of the seat that's up.

results.description: Each seat's place once the game has finished (won, or ended by a forfeit), in seat order, as the server saves it; null until then.

items.title: SeatPlace
items.description: A seat's final place: 1 for the winner; tied seats share one; a forfeit (a team's, in a team game) ranks last.

finishPending.description: The open visit wins the game: it waits for the Finish button (a takeout from the user), so its darts can still be corrected.

canUndoVisit.description: No darts are open and Undo would reopen the last committed visit (its thrower is up again, to correct it).

ownerUserId.description: The host: starts the bull off, aborts the game.

hasHost.description: Whether `ownerUserId` is a host who may end the game. A ranked or tournament game has none: nobody ends it for everyone and either side starts the bull off.

scoreBased.description: The game has a running score the caller announces (the game module's scoreBased).

items.title: SeatInfo
items.description: Who acts for a seat and where its darts come from.

userId.description: The account the seat plays for; null for a guest.

avatar.description: The account's profile picture; {kind: 'none'} for a guest or bot.
avatar.title: Avatar

foreground.description: The finish of the mark in front

background.description: The finish of the disc behind it

boardId.description: null: darts are entered by hand.

controllerConnected.description: The controller has this game open.

disconnectedAt.description: Server time the controller's last socket of this game closed; null while they have it open, or if they haven't opened it since the server started.

bot.description: The server throws for this seat itself, at this difficulty 1-20; null for a human or guest.

spectators.description: Friends watching the game right now (/ws?watch=1); missing: none.

voided.description: A moderator voided this ranked game while it ran: it ended without a result and moved nobody's rating.

anyOf.title: RankedState
anyOf.description: A ranked game's time limit, disconnect timers and stakes. The clock is the server's: a screen counts down from `now` (the server's time when the snapshot was built) and corrects itself with every snapshot.

mode.description: The queue the match came from.

visitSeconds.description: Time each visit gets before the reserve is used.

reserveSeconds.description: The reserve each seat (each team in a team game) starts with.

manualEntry.description: Darts may be entered by hand; when false the server rejects them.

visitDeadline.description: When the visit of the seat that is up runs over and its reserve starts to run. null: no visit clock is running (the bull off before the first visit, a finished game, a visit held for Finish); show the time as paused.

forfeitAt.description: When the seat that is up has used its whole reserve and forfeits the match. null exactly when visitDeadline is.

reserveSeconds.description: Reserve left at `now`, whole seconds, counting the open visit.

inReserve.description: The seat is up and its visit has run over, so its reserve is running.

disconnectForfeitAt.description: Its controller has the game closed: when the seat forfeits if they do not come back; null while they are connected.

stakes.description: RP the seat's side gains for a win and loses for a loss; null while placing.

rating.description: The player's rating (RP) when the match started; null while they are still in their placement matches (the hidden placement rating is never sent) and for a guest or bot.

rankIndex.description: The rank the player held when the match started, 0 (Wood I) to 29 (Elite V) as RankedRating.rankIndex; `rank(i)` from shared/ranked gives the Rank. null while placing.

played.description: Placement matches played before this one.

of.description: Placement matches a player plays before they get a rank.

placement.description: Progress through the placement matches; null once the player has a rank.

change.description: RP the match moved the player by (negative for a loss); null for a placement match, whose rating is hidden. Show `placement` progress instead, and rankIndexAfter on the match that finishes placing.

rankIndexAfter.description: null when the player is still placing after this match.

result.description: What the finished match did to the player's rating; null until the result is recorded (and for a guest, a bot, or a match that was not rated). Promoted is rankIndexAfter above rankIndexBefore.

ranked.description: A ranked game's rules and clock; null or missing for a game that is not ranked.

mission.title: Mission

items.title: MissionStep
items.description: One step of a mission (backend/src/shared/missions/types.ts is the authority).

oneOf.title: MissionCheckoutStep
oneOf.description: Check out `start` within `maxDarts`; a bust fails the attempt.

oneOf.title: MissionHitStep
oneOf.description: Hit each target `hits` times: in a row (a dart that adds nothing fails the attempt), in this order, within N darts or one visit.

items.description: 20: any segment of 20; S20/D20/T20: its single, double or treble; B: either bull; DB: the inner bull.

oneOf.title: MissionMarksStep
oneOf.description: Marks on numbers (25: the bull): a double 2, a treble 3, the outer bull 1, the inner bull 2.

oneOf.title: MissionVisitsStep
oneOf.description: Every visit at least, at most, exactly or never `points`, for `visits` visits.

oneOf.title: MissionScoreStep
oneOf.description: Score `points` or more within `within` darts.

oneOf.title: MissionAverageStep
oneOf.description: A 3-dart average of at least `average` over `visits` visits.

oneOf.title: MissionLegStep
oneOf.description: Win a leg from `start` within `within` darts; a bust ends the visit, as in X01.

highscores.description: The mission's best results when the game started, best first.

items.title: MissionHighscore
items.description: A player's best completed run of a mission.

bests.description: Each account's own best when the game started, by user id; null: none yet. The result's new personal best (the highscores hold only the top 10).

runs.description: Each seat's run, in seat order.

items.title: MissionRun
items.description: One seat's own run through the mission's steps.

active.description: The step the darts go to.

items.title: MissionStepRun
items.description: How a step of the mission stands.

best.description: The most progress an attempt made (a streak's best).

doneAt.description: Mission time (ms) when the step was done.

left.description: Checkout and fast leg: the score left.

restarts.description: Times every step started over (the Start over policy).

darts.description: Darts thrown while the mission ran.

clock.title: MissionClock
clock.description: Server times (ms since the epoch) of the mission's clock: it starts with the first input and stops while paused.

deadline.description: When the seat up runs out of time (ms since the epoch); null without a limit, while paused, or for a seat that waits.

timeMs.description: Mission time when it was completed or failed.

place.description: The seat's place once it is out or the game is over; null while it plays.

chips.description: The open visit's darts and what each did for the step of the seat up.

items.title: MissionChip
items.description: A dart of the open visit and what it did.

gain.description: Progress the dart made (a bust's can be negative).

nextPlayer.description: Who throws after this visit; null when the game ends with it.

winner.description: The seat placed first once every seat is done or out; null while someone plays.

visitLocked.description: The rest of the visit doesn't count: the next step counts whole visits, a fast leg's bust, a pause, or the seat up is out.

timeMs.description: Mission time when it was completed or failed.

game.description: A mission being played (backend/src/games/mission.ts) plus the engine's per-session fields.

allOf.title: EngineGameFields
allOf.description: What the session engine adds to every game's view: the open visit's darts and each seat's darts and visits so far.

items.title: Dart
items.description: A thrown dart. coords/polar are absent for manual entry and bounce-outs.

segment.title: Segment
segment.description: A board segment as Board Manager reports it. Bull 25: bed=Single, number=25. Bull 50: bed=Double, number=50. Miss: name=Miss, number=0, bed=Outside, multiplier=0.

coords.title: Coords
coords.description: Bull-centred, r = 1 at the outer double wire, x right, y up.

test.description: A test run of the author's own mission: counts for no times, XP, stats or history.

mission.title: Mission
mission.description: A mission's definition: what a game of it plays (backend/src/shared/missions/types.ts checks the rest).

items.title: MissionStep
items.description: One step of a mission (backend/src/shared/missions/types.ts is the authority).

oneOf.title: MissionCheckoutStep
oneOf.description: Check out `start` within `maxDarts`; a bust fails the attempt.

oneOf.title: MissionHitStep
oneOf.description: Hit each target `hits` times: in a row (a dart that adds nothing fails the attempt), in this order, within N darts or one visit.

items.description: 20: any segment of 20; S20/D20/T20: its single, double or treble; B: either bull; DB: the inner bull.

oneOf.title: MissionMarksStep
oneOf.description: Marks on numbers (25: the bull): a double 2, a treble 3, the outer bull 1, the inner bull 2.

oneOf.title: MissionVisitsStep
oneOf.description: Every visit at least, at most, exactly or never `points`, for `visits` visits.

oneOf.title: MissionScoreStep
oneOf.description: Score `points` or more within `within` darts.

oneOf.title: MissionAverageStep
oneOf.description: A 3-dart average of at least `average` over `visits` visits.

oneOf.title: MissionLegStep
oneOf.description: Win a leg from `start` within `within` darts; a bust ends the visit, as in X01.

highscores.description: The mission's best results when the game started, best first.

items.title: MissionHighscore
items.description: A player's best completed run of a mission.

bests.description: Each account's own best when the game started, by user id; null: none yet. The result's new personal best (the highscores hold only the top 10).

runs.description: Each seat's run, in seat order.

items.title: MissionRun
items.description: One seat's own run through the mission's steps.

active.description: The step the darts go to.

items.title: MissionStepRun
items.description: How a step of the mission stands.

best.description: The most progress an attempt made (a streak's best).

doneAt.description: Mission time (ms) when the step was done.

left.description: Checkout and fast leg: the score left.

restarts.description: Times every step started over (the Start over policy).

darts.description: Darts thrown while the mission ran.

clock.title: MissionClock
clock.description: Server times (ms since the epoch) of the mission's clock: it starts with the first input and stops while paused.

deadline.description: When the seat up runs out of time (ms since the epoch); null without a limit, while paused, or for a seat that waits.

timeMs.description: Mission time when it was completed or failed.

place.description: The seat's place once it is out or the game is over; null while it plays.

chips.description: The open visit's darts and what each did for the step of the seat up.

items.title: MissionChip
items.description: A dart of the open visit and what it did.

gain.description: Progress the dart made (a bust's can be negative).

nextPlayer.description: Who throws after this visit; null when the game ends with it.

winner.description: The seat placed first once every seat is done or out; null while someone plays.

visitLocked.description: The rest of the visit doesn't count: the next step counts whole visits, a fast leg's bust, a pause, or the seat up is out.

allOf.title: SnapshotBase
allOf.description: The envelope every game's snapshot shares; each <Game>Snapshot adds its gameId and game.

lobbyId.description: The lobby the game was started from; null for a local game.

lobbyName.description: The lobby's name, for the match header; null for a local game.

bmStatus.description: Status of the board of the seat that's up.

results.description: Each seat's place once the game has finished (won, or ended by a forfeit), in seat order, as the server saves it; null until then.

items.title: SeatPlace
items.description: A seat's final place: 1 for the winner; tied seats share one; a forfeit (a team's, in a team game) ranks last.

finishPending.description: The open visit wins the game: it waits for the Finish button (a takeout from the user), so its darts can still be corrected.

canUndoVisit.description: No darts are open and Undo would reopen the last committed visit (its thrower is up again, to correct it).

ownerUserId.description: The host: starts the bull off, aborts the game.

hasHost.description: Whether `ownerUserId` is a host who may end the game. A ranked or tournament game has none: nobody ends it for everyone and either side starts the bull off.

scoreBased.description: The game has a running score the caller announces (the game module's scoreBased).

items.title: SeatInfo
items.description: Who acts for a seat and where its darts come from.

userId.description: The account the seat plays for; null for a guest.

avatar.description: The account's profile picture; {kind: 'none'} for a guest or bot.
avatar.title: Avatar

foreground.description: The finish of the mark in front

background.description: The finish of the disc behind it

boardId.description: null: darts are entered by hand.

controllerConnected.description: The controller has this game open.

disconnectedAt.description: Server time the controller's last socket of this game closed; null while they have it open, or if they haven't opened it since the server started.

bot.description: The server throws for this seat itself, at this difficulty 1-20; null for a human or guest.

spectators.description: Friends watching the game right now (/ws?watch=1); missing: none.

voided.description: A moderator voided this ranked game while it ran: it ended without a result and moved nobody's rating.

anyOf.title: RankedState
anyOf.description: A ranked game's time limit, disconnect timers and stakes. The clock is the server's: a screen counts down from `now` (the server's time when the snapshot was built) and corrects itself with every snapshot.

mode.description: The queue the match came from.

visitSeconds.description: Time each visit gets before the reserve is used.

reserveSeconds.description: The reserve each seat (each team in a team game) starts with.

manualEntry.description: Darts may be entered by hand; when false the server rejects them.

visitDeadline.description: When the visit of the seat that is up runs over and its reserve starts to run. null: no visit clock is running (the bull off before the first visit, a finished game, a visit held for Finish); show the time as paused.

forfeitAt.description: When the seat that is up has used its whole reserve and forfeits the match. null exactly when visitDeadline is.

reserveSeconds.description: Reserve left at `now`, whole seconds, counting the open visit.

inReserve.description: The seat is up and its visit has run over, so its reserve is running.

disconnectForfeitAt.description: Its controller has the game closed: when the seat forfeits if they do not come back; null while they are connected.

stakes.description: RP the seat's side gains for a win and loses for a loss; null while placing.

rating.description: The player's rating (RP) when the match started; null while they are still in their placement matches (the hidden placement rating is never sent) and for a guest or bot.

rankIndex.description: The rank the player held when the match started, 0 (Wood I) to 29 (Elite V) as RankedRating.rankIndex; `rank(i)` from shared/ranked gives the Rank. null while placing.

played.description: Placement matches played before this one.

of.description: Placement matches a player plays before they get a rank.

placement.description: Progress through the placement matches; null once the player has a rank.

change.description: RP the match moved the player by (negative for a loss); null for a placement match, whose rating is hidden. Show `placement` progress instead, and rankIndexAfter on the match that finishes placing.

rankIndexAfter.description: null when the player is still placing after this match.

result.description: What the finished match did to the player's rating; null until the result is recorded (and for a guest, a bot, or a match that was not rated). Promoted is rankIndexAfter above rankIndexBefore.

ranked.description: A ranked game's rules and clock; null or missing for a game that is not ranked.
